doc:
# Basic — Thermalization

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic thermalization”).

claims.name: graviton_mass_parameter_increases_holographic
claims.statement: The graviton mass parameter increases the holographic thermalization process.

sources.title: Holographic Thermalization and Generalized Vaidya-AdS Solutions in Massive Gravity

claims.name: gauss_bonnet_coupling_affects_holographic
claims.statement: The Gauss–Bonnet coupling affects the holographic thermalization process.

sources.title: Effect of massive potentials on the holographic thermalization

claims.name: holographic_thermalization_analyzed_einsteinmaxwellgaussbonnet_gravity
claims.statement: Holographic thermalization is analyzed in Einstein-Maxwell-Gauss-Bonnet gravity.

sources.title: Holographic thermalization with a chemical potential in Gauss-Bonnet gravity

claims.name: thermalization_jet_quenching_treated_within
claims.statement: Thermalization and jet quenching are treated within a holographic framework.

claims.name: using_holographic_methods_paper_probes
claims.statement: Using holographic methods, the paper probes thermalization in gravitational collapse within noncommutative geometry and finds that larger noncommutative parameters delay thermalization, examining how the noncommutative parameter affects thermalization velocity and acceleration.

claims.name: analysis_carried_out_within_framework
claims.statement: The analysis is carried out within the framework of dynamical holographic thermalization.

sources.title: Quantum corrections to dynamical holographic thermalization: entanglement entropy and other non-local observables

claims.name: holographic_thermalization_time_observer_dependent
claims.statement: The holographic thermalization time is observer dependent and has no unambiguous definition.

sources.title: Jet Quenching and Holographic Thermalization with a Chemical Potential

claims.name: paper_also_finds_thermalization_times
claims.statement: The paper also finds that thermalization times extracted from the falling charged shell do not generically track those inferred from non-local observables, implying that holographic thermalization time is observer dependent rather than uniquely defined. This reframes thermalization in charged holographic plasmas as a probe-dependent notion.

sources.title: Jet Quenching and Holographic Thermalization with a Chemical Potential

claims.name: link_between_gravitational_evolution_global
claims.statement: A link between gravitational evolution in global AdS and holographic thermalization is clarified.

sources.title: Position space analysis of the AdS (in)stability problem

claims.name: computed_modes_provide_benchmarks_holographic
claims.statement: The computed modes provide benchmarks for holographic thermalization codes with the appropriate symmetries.

sources.title: Quasinormal modes of magnetic and electric black branes versus far from equilibrium anisotropic fluids

claims.name: effect_massive_graviton_holographic_thermalization
claims.statement: The effect of a massive graviton on the holographic thermalization process is investigated.

sources.title: Holographic Thermalization and Generalized Vaidya-AdS Solutions in Massive Gravity

claims.name: holographic_thermalization_investigated_einstein_gravity
claims.statement: Holographic thermalization is investigated in Einstein gravity coupled to Born-Infeld nonlinear electrodynamics.

sources.title: Holographic thermalization with a chemical potential from Born-Infeld electrodynamics

claims.name: holographic_entanglement_entropy_gives_dominant
claims.statement: The holographic entanglement entropy gives the dominant effect in the thermalization time shift.

sources.title: Holographic thermalization in Gauss-Bonnet gravity with de Sitter boundary

claims.name: holographic_mutual_information_size_kinks
claims.statement: The holographic mutual information and size of the kinks appearing in a large interval are dynamic features of holographic thermalization.

sources.title: Effect of massive potentials on the holographic thermalization

claims.name: thinshell_collapse_asymptotically_ads_spaces
claims.statement: Thin-shell collapse in asymptotically AdS spaces provides a dynamical model of holographic thermalization.

claims.name: thermalization_multi_stress_tensor_operators
claims.statement: Thermalization of multi stress tensor operators is verified in holographic and free CFT examples.

claims.name: holographic_thermalization_borninfeld_electrodynamics_increasing
claims.statement: In holographic thermalization with Born-Infeld electrodynamics, increasing charge delays thermalization (consistent with Maxwell electrodynamics), while increasing Born-Infeld nonlinearity accelerates it; both effects on thermalization velocity and the phase transition between accelerating and decelerating regimes are characterized.

sources.title: Holographic thermalization with a chemical potential from Born-Infeld electrodynamics

claims.name: timeevolution_analysis_provides_more_detailed
claims.statement: The time-evolution analysis provides more detailed information on thermalization in systems with holographic duals.

sources.title: Black holes often saturate entanglement entropy the fastest
